ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity pigmentation field centered at the peduncle and extending to the median notch. Dispersed high-contrast black mottling, speckling, and vertical linear streaks distributed across the lateral lobes, with high density on the distal tips and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (micro-peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, with increased amplitude near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to a sharp upward-sloping trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-intensity white circular marks located on the dark-pigmented distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle scar footprints.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the white-pigmented areas of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the ventral surface and irregular traumatic serrations along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Group of four distinct, parallel vertical black bars on the inner portion of the left lobe.
